sources.entry: ACP Admin - CSA administration. Manage members, subscriptions, deliveries, drop-off locations, member participation, invoices and emails (documentation in French). (Source Code) MIT Ruby

summary.one_liner: A Ruby on Rails web application for managing Community Supported Agriculture (CSA, ACP, Solawi) organizations, covering members, baskets, deliveries, invoicing and newsletters.
summary.what_it_does: CSA/ACP/Solawi Admin manages member records, memberships (basket size, depot location, delivery cycle), and basket complements. It handles delivery cycles such as every two weeks or winter/summer, and basket content with harvest-based quantity calculations and price monitoring. It also supports bidding rounds where members pledge solidarity-based prices within min/max bounds, plus an online grocery store for extra product orders. On the billing side it provides automatic invoicing with QR code and SEPA reference numbers, automatic payment statement import from bank accounts (EBICS 3.0/H005/BTF, BAS, bunq), and overdue notices. It also covers activity participation with member registration forms, transactional email, and a built-in newsletter system, in en, fr, de, it and nl.
use_cases: manage community-supported agriculture members and subscriptions
schedule basket deliveries and drop-off locations
send invoices and overdue payment reminders
run solidarity-based basket pricing bidding rounds
how_to_run: Edit the generated config/tenant.yml with your admin and member hostnames
Open the configured admin_host with .localhost and port 3000 (e.g. admin.example.ch -> admin.example.localhost:3000)
notable: Multi-tenant design with one isolated SQLite database per tenant, resolved from the request host
Bank integration via EBICS 3.0/H005/BTF, BAS and bunq for automatic payment import
Bidding rounds for solidarity-based basket pricing with member pledges
Invoices with QR codes and SEPA reference numbers
Documentation is in French; app is multilingual (en, fr, de, it, nl)
caveats: Development setup depends on Mise 2026.7 or newer and, on Intel macOS, a manual Homebrew install of libvips and Poppler
Contributors are asked to contact the maintainer before substantial work
Demos and custom features require contacting the maintainer; no hosted service is described
